codex-skills.gsd-new-milestone.descripti: Start a new milestone cycle — update PROJECT.md and route to requirements
codex-skills.gsd-new-milestone.short-des: Start a new milestone cycle and route into requirements planning
codex-skills.gsd-progress.description: Check project progress, show context, and route to next action (execute or plan). Use --forensic to append a 6-check integrity audit after the standard report.
codex-skills.gsd-progress.short-descript: Check progress, inspect context, and route to the next execution or planning step
codex-skills.gsd-discuss-phase.descripti: Gather phase context through adaptive questioning before planning. Use --all to skip area selection and discuss all gray areas interactively. Use --auto to skip interactive questions (Claude picks recommended defaults). Use --chain for interactive discuss followed by automatic plan+execute. Use --power for bulk question generation into a file-based UI (answer at your own pace).
codex-skills.gsd-discuss-phase.short-des: Gather phase context and lock decisions before planning
codex-skills.gsd-plan-phase.description: Create detailed phase plan (PLAN.md) with verification loop
codex-skills.gsd-plan-phase.short-descri: Create a detailed phase plan and verify it before execution
codex-skills.gsd-execute-phase.descripti: Execute all plans in a phase with wave-based parallelization
codex-skills.gsd-execute-phase.short-des: Execute all plans in a phase using wave-based grouping
codex-skills.gsd-next.description: Automatically advance to the next logical step in the GSD workflow
codex-skills.gsd-next.short-description: Advance to the next logical step in the GSD workflow
